historical_reviews.deepseek: Leaves GPU/board identity, source Redfish method and post-cycle link/driver health incomplete.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires GPU UUID/BDF/SKU, signed image, explicit AC approval and OOB/vendor recovery.
historical_reviews.related_cases: All-baseboard, FPGA/HMC and retimer activation cases do not substitute for GPU/VBIOS component evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Separates logical HGX_0 from the physical GPU set and requires per-GPU active-version and PCIe/driver recovery proof.

original_test_intent: Stage approved GPU firmware through the correct BMC target, activate it by authorized AC power removal, and verify the intended GPU set has the correct active version without loss of PCIe, driver or host function.
original_method: Map every target GPU UUID/BDF/board/SKU to firmware inventory; preserve current versions, PCIe links, driver and logs; verify signed image/compatibility/rollback; upload once over authenticated Redfish and follow its returned task; operator AC-cycles; re-read per-GPU active firmware and compare complete link/driver/platform health.
manual_activity: Firmware owner selects GPU targets/image and recovery; operator authorizes flash and AC cycle; agent may execute only the exact approved Redfish task and evidence collection.
required_inputs: Target GPU UUID/BDF/board/SKU and HGX_0 mapping
Signed image/hash, current/target active versions and compatibility matrix
Driver/VBIOS dependency, rollback or vendor recovery procedure
BMC certificate/credential policy, task semantics and console/PDU access
Maintenance, job drain, stable power and explicit flash/AC approval
safety_requirements: Never infer which GPU or board HGX_0 represents
Reject unsigned, incompatible or ambiguous image and target
Follow returned task URI; never assume Task 1 or bypass TLS policy
Do not AC-cycle before terminal staging state and operator approval
Stop on task/version/link/driver error; preserve evidence and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture pre-state, upload once after approval and monitor returned task
Collect per-GPU active version, link, driver and health after AC cycle
engineer_actions: Resolve GPU/HGX target mapping and approve image/compatibility/recovery
Authorize disruptive actions and own vendor recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic nvflash/nvsm advice neither proves source Redfish upload nor identifies the GPU set behind HGX_0.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved authenticated Redfish UpdateService against the mapped GPU target, retain returned task data, then after operator AC cycle query per-GPU active firmware and complete PCIe/driver health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HGX_0 and thirty-minute estimate remain source attributes; neither supplies physical GPU identity or a safe timeout.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind image manifest and update task to a per-GPU UUID/BDF/version matrix, then demonstrate active-bank transition and unchanged enumeration/link/driver health after cold activation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical target identity and functional post-activation evidence beyond one aggregate firmware string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic DGX inventory line or upload completion cannot replace per-GPU active firmware validation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GPU firmware incompatibility can make devices disappear before host tools run, so BMC inventory and OOB recovery are independent required evidence.

project_override_considerations: GPU firmware owner defines component granularity, supported board/driver matrix, activation bank behavior and vendor recovery.
expected_evidence: Signed image/hash/compatibility and pre/post per-GPU active versions
Sanitized Redfish target/request, returned task URI and terminal messages
Operator AC event, console/PDU and BMC/host reconnect timestamps
Complete lspci link, GPU enumeration, driver, SEL/dmesg/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item names GPU firmware while Procedure uses generic DGX inventory and one HGX_0 target without identifying which GPU components it updates.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; safe execution awaits normal firmware inputs and the recorded target decision.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row264 Wistron-NV GPU-00257-V002: map the intended GPU UUID/BDF/board/SKU set to HGX_0 and the generic DGX inventory; approve exact signed firmware/VBIOS image, active target versions, driver/board compatibility, task/activation semantics, rollback and AC-cycle/OOB recovery contract.

review_improvement: Requires per-GPU identity and active-version proof plus unchanged PCIe/driver health instead of accepting an aggregate task or inventory line.
independent_technical_reasoning: The Redfish HGX_0 resource may represent a composite tray rather than one GPU, while firmware payloads can target VBIOS, GPU microcontrollers or board devices with different compatibility boundaries. A staged task marked complete is insufficient until cold power causes the intended active-bank change. Post-cycle enumeration and driver binding catch a bad image even when the BMC still reports a version.
